resources.string: Blocks the video, audio and display ads the app requests itself and their verification pings, while ads stitched into the stream need Block embedded ads.
Loads live streams through a third-party proxy in a region without ads, which sees your IP address and the channels you watch, and switches to Twitch for a few minutes when the proxy fails.
Base URL of a Luminous or TTV LOL compatible playlist proxy.
Ignores the ad breaks, picture-by-picture ads and ad tracking that Twitch announces to the app during a stream.
Turns off comScore, Nielsen, Sentry, Crashlytics, Sprig and Branch.
Stops the prompt that offers a newer version from Google Play.
Shows Twitch\'s staff tools, such as the debug menu, the video debug panel, the Ultralight setting and the debug options of its web pages.
